answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce real-world asset: each agent must forge a binding claim on a unique shale deposit parcel, verified by oracle attestation. Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same parcel, and acquiring a second parcel costs full market price plus a multi-epoch lockup extending past the challenge horizon. Attackers must therefore burn real capital per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. The sa0001 deployment anchors trust at iiwSH8Aqvc.
